snippet.title: Vox Populi: Australia 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Vox Populi: Australia 2025 available now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539270/Vox_Populi_Australia_2025

Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for many alternative Australian elections! In "Vox Populi: Australia 2025", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!
